name: SpaceX Crew-12 Farewell and Change of Command Ceremony

vid_urls.title: NASA’s SpaceX Crew-12 Farewell and International Space Station Change of Command
vid_urls.description:
Watch as the members of NASA's SpaceX Crew-12 mission – NASA astronauts Jessica Meir and Jack Hathaway, ESA (European Space Agency) astronaut Sophie Adenot, and Roscosmos cosmonaut Andrey Fedyaev – sum up their experiences aboard the International Space Station and say goodbye to the space station crew. Meir will also transfer command of the orbiting laboratory to Roscosmos cosmonaut Pyotr Dubrov.

Learn more about Crew-12: https://www.nasa.gov/mission/nasas-spacex-crew-12/

name: SpaceX Crew-13 Crew Dragon Docking

vid_urls.title: NASA's SpaceX Crew-13 Arrival & Welcome Remarks
vid_urls.description:
Watch as four explorers arrive at the International Space Station.

After lifting off from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station on Thursday, Oct. 1, at 11:10 a.m. EDT (1510 UTC), Crew-13's spacecraft is scheduled to dock at the orbiting lab at 7 p.m. EDT (2300 UTC), with hatches opening at about 8:45 p.m. EDT (0045 UTC Oct. 2). The crew will also give welcome remarks around 9:20 p.m. EDT (0120 UTC Oct. 2).

NASA astronauts Jessica Watkins and Luke Delaney, CSA (Canadian Space Agency) astronaut Joshua Kutryk, and Roscosmos cosmonaut Sergey Teteryatnikov will spend the next several months in low Earth orbit on NASA's SpaceX Crew-13 mission.

vid_urls.description:
Leaders from NASA and Boeing hold a news conference at NASA's Kennedy Space Center to provide updates on Starliner development and plans for crew flights to and from the International Space Station. 

Briefing participants include:
 
* NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman
* Dana Weigel, manager, NASA’s Low Earth Orbit Program
* Woody Hoburg, NASA astronaut
* John Mulholland, vice president and program manager, Boeing Commercial Crew

Learn more about the Commercial Crew Program: https://www.nasa.gov/commercialcrew
